title: New Year Book Reading
statementMd:
New Year is coming, and Jaehyun decided to read many books during 2015, unlike this year. He has $*n*$ books numbered by integers from 1 to $*n*$. The weight of the $*i*$-th ($1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$) book is $*w*_{*i*}$.

As Jaehyun's house is not large enough to have a bookshelf, he keeps the $*n*$ books by stacking them vertically. When he wants to read a certain book $*x*$, he follows the steps described below.

1. He *lifts* all the books above book $*x*$.
2. He pushes book $*x*$ out of the stack.
3. He puts down the lifted books without changing their order.
4. After reading book $*x*$, he puts book $*x*$ on the top of the stack.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7d983ce19028473d6da894864ce9f696307f80ee.png)

He decided to read books for $*m*$ days. In the $*j*$-th ($1 ≤ *j* ≤ *m*$) day, he will read the book that is numbered with integer $*b*_{*j*}$ ($1 ≤ *b*_{*j*} ≤ *n*$). To read the book, he has to use the process described in the paragraph above. It is possible that he decides to re-read the same book several times.

After making this plan, he realized that the total weight of books he should *lift* during $*m*$ days would be too heavy. So, he decided to change the order of the stacked books before the New Year comes, and minimize the total weight. You may assume that books can be stacked in any possible order. Note that book that he is going to read on certain step isn't considered as *lifted* on that step. Can you help him?

## Input

The first line contains two space-separated integers $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 500$) and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *m* ≤ 1000$) — the number of books, and the number of days for which Jaehyun would read books.

The second line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers $*w*_{1}, *w*_{2}, ..., *w*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *w*_{*i*} ≤ 100$) — the weight of each book.

The third line contains $*m*$ space separated integers $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*m*}$ ($1 ≤ *b*_{*j*} ≤ *n*$) — the order of books that he would read. Note that he can read the same book more than once.

## Output

Print the minimum total weight of books he should *lift*, which can be achieved by rearranging the order of stacked books.

## Note

Here's a picture depicting the example. Each vertical column presents the stacked books.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8e16f95770e35fc57085aa1cf3ff9fe1a4e38c34.png)
statementZhMd:
新年就要到了，与今年不同，Jaehyun 决定在 2015 年读很多书。他有 $*n*$ 本书，编号为从 1 到 $*n*$ 的整数。第 $*i*$（$1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$）本书的重量为 $*w*_{*i*}$。

由于 Jaehyun 的房子不够大，无法摆放书架，所以他把这 $*n*$ 本书竖直堆叠起来。当他想阅读某本编号为 $*x*$ 的书时，会按照以下步骤操作：

1. 他将书 $*x*$ 上方的所有书*提起*。
2. 他将书 $*x*$ 从书堆中抽出。
3. 他放下刚才提起的书，并保持它们的顺序不变。
4. 阅读完书 $*x*$ 后，他将书 $*x*$ 放在书堆的顶端。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7d983ce19028473d6da894864ce9f696307f80ee.png)

他决定用 $*m*$ 天读完这些书。在第 $*j*$（$1 ≤ *j* ≤ *m*$）天，他将阅读编号为 $*b*_{*j*}$ 的书。为了阅读这本书，他必须使用上文所述的过程。他可能会多次重读同一本书。

制定计划后，他意识到在这 $*m*$ 天中需要*提起*的书的总重量会太重。因此，他决定在新年到来之前改变书堆中书的顺序，使总重量最小。你可以假设书籍可以按照任意可能的顺序堆叠。注意，在某一步中，他将要阅读的书不被视为在该步中被*提起*。你能帮助他吗？

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 500$）和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *m* ≤ 1000$）——书的数量以及 Jaehyun 计划读书的天数。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个用空格分隔的整数 $*w*_{1}, *w*_{2}, ..., *w*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *w*_{*i*} ≤ 100$）——每本书的重量。

第三行包含 $*m*$ 个用空格分隔的整数 $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*m*}$（$1 ≤ *b*_{*j*} ≤ *n*$）——他将阅读的书的顺序。注意，他可以多次阅读同一本书。

## 输出格式

输出通过重新排列书堆中书的顺序所能达到的、需要*提起*的书的总重量的最小值。
